```python
from pocket_coffea.lib.categorization import Binning, CartesianMultiBinning

# Define jet multiplicity binning for JetGood collection
njets_binning = Binning(
    name="njets",
    bins=[
        ("njets_4", 4, 5),      # exactly 4 jets
        ("njets_5", 5, 6),      # exactly 5 jets
        ("njets_ge6", 6, None), # at least 6 jets
    ]
)

# Define b-tag multiplicity binning
nbtags_binning = Binning(
    name="nbtags",
    bins=[
        ("nbtags_2", 2, 3),      # exactly 2 b-tags
        ("nbtags_ge3", 3, None), # at least 3 b-tags
    ]
)

# Create analysis categories as cartesian product
analysis_categories = CartesianMultiBinning(
    binnings=[njets_binning, nbtags_binning]
)
```
